feeds.description: Kansas City's no.1 Website for Moms. Local resources, activity and event calendar, free deals, coupons, KC special events, Kansas City Moms & more.

feeds.title: Covet by Tricia
feeds.description: COVET by Tricia is a lifestyle, fashion, and beauty blog for the modern female. Hi, I'm Tricia! Mom of 2 and a former lawyer turned blogger. COVET by Tricia is where I share my with you, the reader - good deals I find, outfits that are comfortable yet stylish, fun trips to take with your family, and everything in between.

feeds.title: This Kansas City Mama
feeds.description: I'm Andrea of This Kansas City Mama! I'm a mama, wife, blogger, DIY enthusiast, a self-professed fashionista, and mompreneur. On this blog I am sharing all of my favorite things from fashion to home decor, places to explore around Kansas City, and so much more.

feeds.title: Mindfully Gray
feeds.description: Mindfully Gray is a home decor and lifestyle blog by Brett & Jamie. On the blog we share about fixing up our first home inside and out, navigating life as new parents, DIY projects, home renovations, and more!

feeds.title: Mrs. Kansas Mommy
feeds.description: Candid musings for the modern mommy. Come for the hair and makeup tips, stay for the inappropriate sense of humor.

feeds.title: Crazy Bananas
feeds.description: Crazy Bananas Creative Studio is a personal blog about photography, design, parenting, recovery and life in general!
